title: Remove Vertical Gaps (AlignAndSize)

scenarios.title: Remove Vertical Gaps applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Remove Vertical Gaps (BtnRemoveVerticalGaps) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Remove Vertical Gaps packs vertically and keeps the centred bounding box
scenarios.expected: With the top shape anchored the vertical plan moves the shapes to Top 0 / 10 / 30, leaves every Left value untouched and leaves no vertical gap; the centred command packs around the middle of the original bounding box so the centre is unchanged, and both routes are idempotent.

requirements.text: Remove vertical gaps packs the selection vertically and preserves the bounding-box center when centered.

scenarios.expected: Remove vertical gaps packs the selection vertically and preserves the bounding-box center when centered.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
